bibl.title: Recontextualizing Nilotic Scenes: Interactive Landscapes in the Garden of the Casa dell'Efebo, Pompeii.
bibl.seg: Caitlín E. Barrett, Recontextualizing Nilotic Scenes: Interactive Landscapes in the Garden of the Casa dell'Efebo, Pompeii.
bibl.note: Introduction. - The Casa dell'Efebo and its garden. - The Nilescapes of the Casa dell'Efebo garden triclinium. - Adaptation, emulation, and eclectism in Nilotic imagery. - Interactive landscapes in the garden: Dining on the "Nile"; - Performing pastoral piety; - Universal and local; - Safety, danger, and fantasy in the domestic locus amoenus; - Fertility, prosperity, and stability; - Interactive statuary: social performance and service; - Performing cosmopolitanism. - Conclusion: Borderlands and margins; - Plural audiences, plural responses; - Domesticating empire.
